They are not themselves binding law but provide the Commission's interpretation. Ireland and Denmark have opt-out provisions for certain RBI prohibitions. Prohibitions apply to placing on market, putting into service, and use, including misuse. General-purpose AI systems are covered. Continuous compliance throughout AI lifecycle is required.","confidence":0.88}
